messages.subject: Notes for tables in html format (kable)
messages.subject_clean: Notes for tables in html format (kable)
messages.body_plain:
Hello,
I am using kable to output my tables in to an html document. I would like to add notes to the table but read in SO that knitr doesn't have this feature.
Any ideas?
Thanks on advance.
Fernando

messages.body_plain:
Your question is not clear. Specifically, your term "notes" is not clear, and you should cite (link?) who said it was not possible.

For example,  you can easily add a column to your data frame that has per-row comments. This being so obvious, the reader wonders what else you might have been thinking of.
